description: Manage your sites in Bing Webmaster Tools: submit pages and sitemaps for crawling, read search queries, clicks and impressions, check crawl issues and inbound links, and run workflows when something changes.

bing_webmaster_tools_new_crawl_issue_tri.description: Runs when Bing reports a new problem crawling a page of your site (an error, a redirect, a robots.txt block or malware). Issues already listed when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.http_code: The status code Bing got for the page
output.in_links: Links to the page Bing knows of
output.issue_names: What Bing found wrong, such as Client error (4xx)
output.issues: Bing's issue flags, as a number

parameters.description: The site in Bing Webmaster Tools to watch.
parameters.name: site_url

bing_webmaster_tools_new_top_query_trigg.description: Runs when a search appears among your site's top Bing queries for the first time, with its clicks and impressions. Bing updates them weekly.

output.date: The day (or week start) the figures are for, ISO 8601 UTC
output.impressions: Times shown in Bing search results

parameters.description: The site in Bing Webmaster Tools to watch.
parameters.name: site_url

bing_webmaster_tools_new_traffic_day_tri.description: Runs when Bing adds a day's clicks and impressions for your site, usually once a day.

output.date: The day (or week start) the figures are for, ISO 8601 UTC
output.impressions: Times shown in Bing search results

parameters.description: The site in Bing Webmaster Tools to watch.
parameters.name: site_url

bing_webmaster_tools_site_verified_trigg.description: Runs when a site in your Bing Webmaster Tools account becomes verified. Sites already verified when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.authentication_code: The code for the msvalidate.01 meta tag or BingSiteAuth.xml file
output.dns_verification_code: The CNAME record that verifies the site
output.is_verified: True once Bing has verified you own it
output.url: The site's address, as Bing lists it

bing_webmaster_tools_sitemap_read_trigge.description: Runs each time Bing reads one of your site's sitemaps or feeds, with its status and how many URLs it holds.

output.last_crawled: When Bing last read it, ISO 8601 UTC
output.status: How Bing last read it, such as Success
output.submitted: When it was submitted, ISO 8601 UTC

parameters.description: The site in Bing Webmaster Tools to watch.
parameters.name: site_url
